overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating entailment tree explanations for QA using T5 models. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization of metric variants and removal of duplicate/placeholder items. The human evaluation was more limited than initially extracted - primarily focused on overall correctness validation rather than multiple fine-grained criteria.
